itemized.notes: October 30 interim (period ending 2012-10-28), signed 10/30/12, clerk RECEIVED OCT 30 2012, office 'Salt Lake County Council - District 4'. The filer left both clerk grids blank with '* See Attached *' and supplied two typed attachments: 'Contributions through 10/29/12' (PDF pages 4-6, printed LANDSCAPE, rotated 90 deg COUNTER-CLOCKWISE to read) and 'EXPENDITURES THROUGH 10-29-12' (PDF page 8, printed LANDSCAPE the OTHER WAY, rotated 90 deg CLOCKWISE - the two attachments in the SAME filing have opposite rotation signs). The contributions attachment has NO street-address column at all - it publishes CITY and STATE only - so donor geography here is complete rather than redacted (the black redaction box in this filing covers only the candidate's own address on the cover page). IN-KIND is marked by the word 'In Kind' in the EMPLOYER column on the contributions attachment and to the right of the amount on the expenditures attachment; five in-kind items appear on both sides (Leslie Reberg 280.98; Internet Properties 600.00 twice; Gastronomy 1,066.74; Sam Granato 200.00; Aristo Greek Restaurant 500.00) and both printed totals include them. Two aggregate/unnamed contributor rows are transcribed verbatim and never given names: 'Cash Contributions' ($130.00) and 'Gastronomy' (no city/state). One contributor name is physically clipped by the adjoining column ('S.W. Region Council of Carpen'). One date is a filer typo ('10/8/2001' among 10/8/2012 rows), kept verbatim. The attachment also carries OCCUPATION and EMPLOYER columns for which the per-row contract has no slot.
